text:
morgan: Originating RC: serving-rcA-2026-03-17. Pin request: prod window 16:00-17:00 UTC. Artifact: gcr.redwood/inference/serving:2026-03-17-rcA

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: artifact discovered. sha256: ab12cd34ef56... Canary plan: 5% -> 25% (10m) -> 100% if metrics ok.

qa-nate: running a quick staging smoke, will post back in ~12m

morgan: draft release notes: https://docs.redwood.ai/relnotes/2026-03-17-rcA.md. Check breaking changes: model reload semantics.

kevin: note: infra has a DB migration at 16:20-16:40 UTC. can we nudge promo to 16:45? @sheriff-jen

sheriff-jen: agree to avoid overlap. propose start 16:50, quiet window 60m. I'll be oncall.

priya: telemetry: recommend enabling model-llamaKV.hot_start=true and X-RDWD-EVAL header during rollout to help KV warm and trace.

deploy-bot: deploy plan created: steps: 1) pin artifact, 2) deploy 5% canary, 3) monitor P95 <200ms & error <0.5% for 10m, 4) ramp to 25% -> 100%, 5) unpin old.

qa-nate: smoke failing on embeddings with long inputs: TimeoutError: 10s context window exceeded. log snippet: ```ERROR: context window exceeded at model_infer (/srv/runner/infer.py:342) TimeoutError: 10s```

deploy-bot: incident created INC-2026-045 embeddings-timeout-staging

sheriff-jen: hold promo. freeze until QA triages. @morgan

priya: try batching.max_batch_time_ms=5 as a config override to mitigate.

morgan: QA apply and re-smoke. Need decision by 16:40 to keep change window.

deploy-bot: applied override on staging: batching.max_batch_time_ms=5, model-llamaKV.hot_start=true

qa-nate: rerun: embeddings OK on long inputs, latency slightly up but within P95. No errors in 20m smoke.

morgan: bake until 16:50 then canary 5% at 16:50. Sheriff?

sheriff-jen: bake until 16:45 then canary at 16:50. Rollback criteria: >1% abs error increase or P95>250ms for 5m.

kevin: coordinating infra migration—moved to 17:10.

pm-lina: release notes updated with workaround snippet. publishing to announcements once promo starts.

morgan: pin approved by morgan, priya, qa-nate, sheriff-jen. pin at 16:45.

deploy-bot: pin complete /pins/serving/production -> gcr.redwood/inference/serving:2026-03-17-rcA. scheduled canary 16:50 slot-3.

16:50 deploy-bot: canary deployed slot-3 5%

monitoring-bot: telemetry P95=180ms error_rate=0.11% (5m)

morgan: proceed to 25% in 10m if stable.

17:01 monitoring-bot: P95=195ms error_rate=0.15%

sheriff-jen: metrics green, ramp to 25%

deploy-bot: traffic shifted to 25%

monitoring-bot: P95=225ms error_rate=0.24%

pm-lina: preparing release announcement

morgan: plan 100% at 17:25 if green. keep rollback until 17:45

17:26 monitoring-bot: P95=255ms error_rate=0.85% (5m)

sheriff-jen: P95 exceeded! initiating rollback to previous stable tag 2026-03-10-stable

deploy-bot: rolling back -> gcr.redwood/inference/serving:2026-03-10-stable

monitoring-bot: post-rollback P95=185ms error_rate=0.09%

morgan: rollback confirmed. Root cause: batching + optimizer path causing tail latency at higher traffic. Action items: (1) perf deep-dive (owner: priya) (2) add stress tests to canary (owner: kevin) (3) update release notes with rollback summary (owner: pm-lina)

priya: ack, will investigate and propose hotfix plan.

qa-nate: will add embedding long-input scenarios to canary checks.

sheriff-jen: creating follow-up ticket and will close thread when tracked.
